name: Beatrice Du Cae
source:
With a sharp mind and an equally sharp tongue, Beatrice is ready to become Caerulia's next ruler. Though she may face a number of troubles before sitting on the throne, Beatrice is more than determined to prove her worth.

Likes: Ruling, archery, music, creampuffs

Dislikes: Gossip, cats
